instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to learn about the highest common factor.

atoms.b: The highest common factor of two numbers is the largest number that both numbers can be ((++divided multiplied)) by exactly.
After writing down all the factors for 12 and 18, you can see that their highest common factor is <mat><gap>2 3 ++6</gap></mat>.
Therefore, we could rewrite the expression <mat>12a+18b</mat> as <mat><gap>++6(2a+3b) 6(3a+2b)</gap></mat>.
